senses.gloss: Cola^1, pl. (ºāḥ), a people in the present Tanjore (BR.). § 342 (Indralokābh.): III, 34, 1988 (mahīpālān… so-Cola-Draviḍāndhrakān, present at the rājasūya of Yudhishṭhira).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 357 (in the south).-§ 589 (Droṇābhishekap.): VII, 11, 398 (had been vanquished by Kṛshṇa).--§ 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 12, 455 (fight on the side of the Pāṇḍavas).
Cola^2, “king of the Colas.” § 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 52, 1893 (ºPāṇḍyau, bring tribute to Yudhishṭhira).
